I can't find a name for Kwame's night-dispatch contact at Driftmoor Marine Freight. The notes I can see only say that engineering gave "the night dispatcher" a manual CSV patch after the tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B. They also say Driftmoor asked for a patched manifest CSV before a 06:00 shift. Neither one names the person or gives an email address.

Don't use "Hector". He's the night dispatcher at Pellucid Harbor Logistics, Kwame's Gulf Coast account, not Driftmoor.

Kwame owns that account, so he's the quickest way to get the name. If the contact is outside pemberline.com, I'd need Ruth Calloway's approval before I could address or draft mail to them. I can ask her once you have the address.
